description: 11-bus, 325-bus rural, 254-bus suburban, and 324-bus urban feeders for power flow calculation is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Pedro Vasconcelos. "This dataset includes power system data for power flow and economic analysis of different radial distribution feeders, including distributed generation data and value of lost load (VOLL). It includes four test cases: an 11-bus system and realistic 325-bus rural, 254-bus suburban, and 324-bus urban radial test feeders. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
